issue.title: ADR report bundle omits the ADR incident selector source
issue.actual: The screen's first rule permits an ADR report only for an ADVERSE_DRUG_REACTION incident. The bundle names detail/report calls with incident_id, but gives no starting list or named handoff. A direct menu entry has no incident to open.
issue.expected: Name the incident register handoff or list GET /incidents?type_code=ADVERSE_DRUG_REACTION as the selector, with its existing permission rules. The client can list only ADR records and open the actual selected incident.
issue.steps: Read current get_screen_bundle('adr_report') including endpoints and handoffs, then read get_endpoint for GET /incidents. Call the directory using the documented filter as demo.quality. Compare the resulting available source with the operations named in the bundle.
issue.evidence: DEV build 2026-11-07T10:03:18.175586+00:00. Actual source GET 200, request_id 34854e91e96549748d8ea0079bc7bbcf. The selected filter had zero demo records. This report is about the missing source in the bundle. The existing call is available and permission checked.
